scenarios.title: A｜请假
scenarios.setting: 玩家需要请一天假，于是提前和经理沟通。

turns.text: Hi, could I talk to you about taking some time off?
Sure. What dates are you thinking about?

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to take next Friday off, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to take next Friday off, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “take + 某天 + off”表示那天请假，能清楚说明需要调整哪一天的工作安排。

choices.text: Would it be okay if I took Friday off next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I took Friday off next week?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I was hoping to take a day off next Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was hoping to take a day off next Friday.
feedback.explanation: “day off”谈的是请假或休假，能把工作安排与普通的休息区分开。

choices.text: I’d like to request two days off at the end of the month.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request two days off at the end of the month.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I want to rest next Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to take next Friday off, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 请一天假用“take Friday off”；“rest”只表示休息，未明确向主管提出请假安排。

turns.text: Friday should be okay. Do you have anything due that day?

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, I’ll make sure everything is finished before then.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I’ll make sure everything is finished before then.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: I have one task due Thursday, but it should be done before I leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have one task due Thursday, but it should be done before I leave.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I’ll hand over anything urgent before I take the day off.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll hand over anything urgent before I take the day off.
feedback.explanation: “day off”谈的是请假或休假，能把工作安排与普通的休息区分开。

choices.text: I can also leave notes for the team in case anything comes up.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can also leave notes for the team in case anything comes up.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Sounds good. Just submit the request in the system.

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I’ll do that today. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll do that today. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, thank you. I’ll make sure everything’s covered.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you. I’ll make sure everything’s covered.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

scenarios.title: B｜调班
scenarios.setting: 在“请假与工作时间”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“调班”。

turns.text: Hey, could I ask you about my schedule next week?

turns.prompt: 你想提出调换工作班次的请求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Would it be possible to switch my Tuesday shift to Thursday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to switch my Tuesday shift to Thursday?
feedback.explanation: “shift”指一班工作时段，换班时需要说清原时段和新时段。

choices.text: Is there any chance I could work Thursday instead of Tuesday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any chance I could work Thursday instead of Tuesday?
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

choices.text: I need to change one of my shifts next week. Who should I talk to?

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to change one of my shifts next week. Who should I talk to?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Could I swap shifts with someone if they’re okay with it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I swap shifts with someone if they’re okay with it?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Can I change my Tuesday work to Thursday?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to switch my Tuesday shift to Thursday?
feedback.explanation: 班次叫“shift”，比“Tuesday work”更明确；换班需说清原时段和目标时段。

turns.text: You can switch with someone as long as they agree.

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll ask Jamie if she’d be willing to swap with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll ask Jamie if she’d be willing to swap with me.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. Do I need to let you know once we’ve agreed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do I need to let you know once we’ve agreed?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is there anything we need to update in the system?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything we need to update in the system?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: Just let me know, and I’ll update the schedule.

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll talk to her and get back to you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll talk to her and get back to you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜讨论加班
scenarios.setting: 临近下班，经理询问玩家是否可以留下来处理一个紧急任务。

turns.text: We have something urgent that needs to be finished tonight. Would you be able to stay a little later?

turns.prompt: 你想了解还需要多少时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Sure. How much longer do you think we’ll need?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. How much longer do you think we’ll need?
feedback.explanation: “How much longer”问还要多久，关注从现在起剩余的等待时间。

choices.text: I can stay for another hour or two. What needs to be done?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay for another hour or two. What needs to be done?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I should be able to. What do you need me to finish?

feedback.naturalExpression: I should be able to. What do you need me to finish?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: I can stay until about eight tonight. Would that be enough?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay until about eight tonight. Would that be enough?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Yes, I can overtime tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. How much longer do you think we’ll need?
feedback.explanation: “overtime”不是动词；加班用“work overtime”，如“I can work overtime tonight”。

turns.text: Probably about two hours. We need to get these files ready for the client.

turns.prompt: 你想确认加班时应优先处理哪些文件，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Which files should I focus on?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Which files should I focus on?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Got it. What’s the highest priority?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. What’s the highest priority?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll finish my current task first and then work on those.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll finish my current task first and then work on those.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Do you need me to stay until everything is finished?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you need me to stay until everything is finished?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

turns.text: Just focus on the first three. Someone else will handle the rest.

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I can do that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I can do that.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Sounds good. I’ll start on them now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. I’ll start on them now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己今天无法留下加班，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t stay late tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I can’t stay late tonight.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Unfortunately, I have something I can’t move this evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, I have something I can’t move this evening.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I can stay for about thirty minutes, but I can’t stay much later than that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay for about thirty minutes, but I can’t stay much later than that.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I can’t stay tonight, but I could come in earlier tomorrow morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t stay tonight, but I could come in earlier tomorrow morning.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: That’s okay. Just finish what you can before you leave.

turns.prompt: 关于「请假与工作时间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I’ll prioritize the most urgent part.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll prioritize the most urgent part.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll send you what I’ve finished before I leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll send you what I’ve finished before I leave.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
